    cur2.execute("SET SESSION CHARACTERISTICS AS TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE;")

    cur2.execute("COMMIT;")


    cur1.execute("DELETE FROM tEJybmqs WHERE ( tEJybmqs.c1 = FALSE );")
